autonom: candidate Organism integration: RepositoryEffectGuard and ChangeLeaseStore; exact native signatures not available
guard-agent: host/container anomaly observations; not a substitute for repository effect authorization
hostguard: host resource/process monitoring; not repository admission
core: process-pack validation/compiler and URI ownership/collision checks
runtime: AQL/OQL, operational DSL, process clients and evidence integration
connectors: connector manifest inventory and guarded provider bindings
subllm: request-only LLM proposal/semantic review, never execution authority
shell: operator-facing control surface through typed adapter
coding-agent: scoped code-change proposal in a separate authorized worktree
repair-agent: bounded repair proposal; fresh plan required before effects
doctor-agent: repository/environment diagnosis; diagnosis is not proof of success
queue-agent: queue scheduling, separate from command authorization
urirun-contract: existing contract exports; do not duplicate generator
urirun-flow: existing process composition; do not replace runtime
repository-publisher-agent: separate protected publication, not invoked by extraction
onedev-agent: separate forge integration, not invoked by extraction
credential-vault: short-lived credential references only; no secrets copied into packages
